info.name: SureStep API - Multi-Role Workflows
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for manual testing of SureStep dementia care platform. Demonstrates user roles (PATIENT, CAREGIVER, FAMILY) and full end-to-end workflows with automated variable chaining.

request.description: Basic health check returning server status, version, and timestamp.
Diagnostic check of database connectivity, DNS, and TCP port 5432.
Applies pending database migrations and returns status.
Uses mock-dev-patient-token to auto-provision patient user. Captures patientId.
Sets emergency contact and dementia stage for the patient.
Uses mock-dev-caregiver-token to auto-provision caregiver user. Captures caregiverId.
Updates caregiver rates, experience, and enables is_discoverable for search.

request.description: Uses mock-dev-family-token to auto-provision family user. Captures familyId.
Configures notification preferences and relationship label for family member.
Family searches for eligible, discoverable caregivers in Bangalore.

Family initiates care request for the patient.
